say.en: A note from Bavko? For me? Thank you!
say.sl: Sporočilo od Bavka? Zame? Hvala!

say.en: Your bag holds treats for wild creatures, and here are three more. Look inside any time.
say.sl: V torbi imaš poslastice za divja bitja, tu so še tri. Poglej vanjo, kadar želiš.

say.en: Oh, the meadow creatures are so jumpy today! Could you calm them down? Win 2 battles in the tall grass.
say.sl: Oh, bitja na travniku so danes tako nemirna! Jih pomiriš? Zmagaj v 2 bojih v visoki travi.

say.en: Leave it to me!
say.sl: Prepusti meni!

say.en: Not now.
say.sl: Ne zdaj.

say.en: Great! The tall grass is right here. Come back when you're done.
say.sl: Super! Visoka trava je kar tu. Vrni se, ko končaš.

say.en: Of course, of course. The grass will wait. It always does.
say.sl: Seveda, seveda. Trava bo počakala. Vedno počaka.

say.en: Two wins in the tall grass, and the meadow will settle down. I believe in you!
say.sl: Dve zmagi v visoki travi in travnik se bo umiril. Verjamem vate!

say.en: Listen! The meadow has calmed down. Great work!
say.sl: Poslušaj! Travnik se je umiril. Odlično opravljeno!

say.en: Now for my favourite part. Offer a treat to a wild creature in battle. If it likes you, it joins your team!
say.sl: Zdaj pa moj najljubši del. V boju ponudi poslastico divjemu bitju. Če te ima rado, se pridruži tvoji ekipi!

say.en: I'll try it!
say.sl: Poskusim!

say.en: Not now.
say.sl: Ne zdaj.

say.en: Wonderful! A tired creature says yes more often. And its favourite treat works best.
say.sl: Čudovito! Utrujeno bitje pogosteje reče ja. Najbolje deluje njegova najljubša poslastica.

say.en: Any luck yet? Offer a treat in battle. Tired creatures say yes more often.
say.sl: Ti je že uspelo? V boju ponudi poslastico. Utrujena bitja pogosteje rečejo ja.

say.en: Out of treats? Oh dear, oh dear! Here, take three plain ones. Everyone deserves another try.
say.sl: Ti je zmanjkalo poslastic? Ojej, ojej! Na, vzemi tri navadne. Vsakdo si zasluži še en poskus.

say.en: A new teammate! Look how happy it is. That's what treats are for.
say.sl: Novo bitje v ekipi! Poglej, kako je veselo. Za to so poslastice.

say.en: Vetrinka says there's something odd in the clouds. I've packed extra treats, just in case.
say.sl: Vetrinka pravi, da je v oblakih nekaj čudnega. Za vsak primer imam pripravljenih več poslastic.

say.en: Treats, bags, and more treats. That's my job!
say.sl: Poslastice, torbe in še več poslastic. To je moje delo!

say.en: Treats you make yourself work even better! Pick 3 cloudberries, then cook a Berry Bun in my pot.
say.sl: Domače poslastice delujejo še bolje! Naberi 3 oblačnice, nato v mojem loncu skuhaj jagodno žemljico.

say.en: Let's cook!
say.sl: Kuhajmo!

say.en: Not now.
say.sl: Ne zdaj.

say.en: The berry bushes are near the post, and the pot is right here by me.
say.sl: Grmi z jagodami so blizu pošte, lonec pa je kar tu ob meni.

say.en: Three cloudberries, then a Berry Bun in the pot. Easy and tasty!
say.sl: Tri oblačnice, nato jagodna žemljica v loncu. Preprosto in okusno!

say.en: For me? Thank you!
say.sl: Zame? Hvala lepa!

say.en: A job from the board? Bring it all when you have it.
say.sl: Opravilo z deske? Prinesi vse, ko zbereš.
